name: Kling AI (China)
tagline: Create images and videos with the official Kling AI China MCP service
description: Connect to the hosted Kling AI China MCP service for image and video generation workflows. Sign in with a China account using OAuth. Generation consumes paid personal-workspace credits; China and Global accounts, credits, and tasks are separate. Available models and parameters depend on the authenticated account. The linked GitHub repository contains a client plugin and Skills, not the hosted server source.

install.notes: After installation, complete OAuth for your China Kling account. Confirm generation settings before submitting a paid task.
